listing.name: Metroid Dread (Metroid-Dread-Recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C ahead of time; native host runtime, Vulkan/OpenGL graphics. Upstream maturity: 0.x early previews, proper1.0 planned; crashes/setup/hardware rough edges. No Portcove test. Acquisition: Release launcher bundles GCC/Python and compiles game locally on first start. Upstream launcher owns update/undo. Platforms: Windows x64 release ZIP. Linux/Steam Deck scripts exist; exact native Linux CPU/build/testing scope not established by root README. Original data: Own Metroid Dread 2.1.0 ExeFS (main/main.npdm and companions) plus RomFS with update merged. RomFS alone is insufficient. Separate base/update dumps accepted. No separate keys/firmware input described for extracted route; exact region/executable digest Unknown. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
